ITEM 1 | Glossy, sticky brown-amber glaze over irregular chunky pieces with browned, slightly charred edges; sits at upper right of the plate, roughly 9 x 12 cm footprint, about 2.5 cm thick | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-cream soft, smooth mound with a slightly grainy surface, moist and holding a soft shape; sits just below the glazed pieces, about 6 x 4 cm and 1.5 cm high | 40
ITEM 3 | Crisp, ribbed, deep green leaves with a matte, slightly wet surface and some darker wilted edges; spread across the lower right of the plate in a loose pile, about 19 x 12 cm footprint but thin, around 1 cm deep | 60
ITEM 4 | Pale yellow-green limp leaves with a slightly glossy, moist sheen, partly overlapping the dark green leaves in the center of the plate, about 14 x 6 cm and under 1 cm thick | 25
ITEM 5 | Small orange-tan piece with a firm, smooth-looking surface, tucked under the pale leaves near the center, about 2 x 1.5 cm | 5
ITEM 6 | A few small bright green leaves on a thin stem lying across the glazed pieces at upper right, each leaf about 1 to 2 cm | 2
